text: Why Doug pay five dollars for gas in America...
but nine cents in Libya?
Same gas.
This is Doug.
Doug drive snowmobile to work.
Snowmobile drink gas. Every week, Doug fill the tank.
Gas come from oil. Oil come from ground.
Libya sit on the biggest oil pile in all of Africa.
But oil is not free. Pull it out, clean it, ship it. Cost money.
Real price of gas is not nine cents.
So who pay the rest? In Libya, Boss Bear pay.
Every gallon, Boss Bear pay. Driver pay almost nothing.
This is called subsidy.
In America, no Boss Bear.
Nobody pay for Doug.
Doug pay for oil. Doug pay for refinery. And Tax Gull take fifty cents. Every gallon.
Doug angry.
In real life, America pay about four dollars forty. California pay over six.
Libya pay nine cents.
Doug fill twelve gallons. America, fifty three dollars. Libya, one dollar.
Doug pay fifty times more. Same gas.
Doug pack bags.
Bye bye, America.
But cheap gas is not free for Libya.
Boss Bear spend oil money on gas, not on roads and hospitals.
And smugglers buy cheap gas and sell it in other countries.
Doug confused.
Would you move to Libya for nine cent gas? Tell Doug in the comments.
